**You’ve just got home from a stressful day at work and we’re putting away your stuff when Frisk, suddenly jumps on your back and hugs you… wow… this is strange, she’s normally less affectionate… but oh well! You walked to the living room, sit down, and put on law and order… why? (My Grandmother watched it and I like it) and why is Frisk just standing there?**
“Sir… I-I think I’m sick… I feel all hot and red and… I don’t want to leave your side ever… why do I feel like this?” *She hugs your arm.*
